snippet.title: Discover Dewdrop Roots | Quest Master’s Forest Theme | Available Now!
snippet.description:
🌿 Play now on Steam: ► http://apo.gg/QuestMaster
Welcome to Dewdrop Roots, one of the original dungeon themes in Quest Master, the Zelda-like dungeon maker built for creators and adventurers.

As we approach our 1.0 launch, Quest Master has evolved into a creative force shaped by 5,000+ community-made dungeons. But we’re not done yet. Our team is hard at work crafting a full Single Player Campaign using the same maker tools you have access to. Expect a story-rich world, memorable characters, and new surprises waiting to be uncovered.

Build your own dungeons
Explore thousands of community levels

-

-
Produced by Jeron Moore & Kyle Blessing
Directed & Edited by Kyle Blessing
Motion Graphics by Klevin MacKlaverty
Capture Artist: Kyle Blessing and Julian Creutz
Quest Master Them & Trailer Music Composer: Chipper Hammond
Executive Producer: Jeron Moore

Discover Dewdrop Roots | Quest Master’s Forest Theme | Available Now!
